notes.title: Update noted for 17 August 2024
notes.content:
- Added a brighter range for gamma adjustment.
- Main item diary scales to position more accurately with wider monitors and graphic covers 
   whole screen.
- Placing "Geralds favorite game" map on study desk bug is fixed where camera wouldn't 
   zoom in for a close up as intended.

notes.title: Update notes for 11th August 2024
notes.content:
- You can now use the w (forward) and s (back) keys to exit an area or object that's being examined rather than just going through your Tab item menu.
- More story and information has been added to discoverable notes and more context to story is given to why there is a mini game involved.
- Various minor fixes.

- IMPORTANT INFO ON SAVES -
- Due to a background update on the save menu slots to allow for additional saves for the coming second level, your existing saves will be out of sync by one slot.

notes.title: Quick patch PLUS 30th June
notes.content: - Fixed animation state of inside of the coffee table not re-loading properly

notes.title: Quick patch notes 30th June
notes.content:
- Fixed bug to stop the use of the protractor when completing the mini game.
- Fixed the moving pad in the mini game from moving through certain objects.

notes.title: Quick patch 27th June
notes.content: Increased mouse maximum sensitivity and added minor adjustments.

notes.title: Update notes for 25th June 2024
notes.content:
Mini game bug / fixes
- Respawning your character around the outer edges of the map no longer locks your cursor to the center of the screen.
- Blob enemies no longer inflict damage on the player when idle after defeated.
- Jet packing on the pad no longer freezes character mid air.

Other fixes
- Hidden object in coffee table can no longer be selected when lid is closed.

Other updates
- Dial lock has a key use hint.
- Added some more grossness to a particular model.
- Darkness now ensues at the end.

notes.title: Update notes for June 2nd (various fixes and aesthetical changes)
notes.content:
- A quick story intended to be revealed later has been added to the beginning instead.

- General lighting and menu aesthetical changes.

Bugs and fixes.
- Map now stops disappearing from study desk upon re-load.
- Wall candle lever puzzle doesn't get stuck.
- When exiting the gut bile examination with the bottle held resets the bottle rather than it blocking your view with a white screen.
- A clue is now given when trying to extract the bile into the bottle.
- You can't repeatedly tap on the computer desk drawer to force it open.
- Matchbox in cupboard mini game now works as intended by not allowing you to select other objects after jump scares.
- Cupboard mini game only utilizes the jump scare punishment mechanic only twice avoiding repetition.
- Tentacle freeze no longer happens in the top-down mini shooter puzzle.

notes.title: Update notes 25th February
notes.content:
- Various texture adjustments on certain objects
- Hag clipping computer chair fixed
- Addition of minor clues
- Better inventory and exit tutorial including a Drag Rotate icon
- Knife more visible for selection in drawer
- Various minor bug fixes

notes.title: Update notes 27th January 2024
notes.content:
Protractor / Map puzzle 

- Hag only appears once and an error message and sound play instead when incorrect angles are entered.
- Protractors rotation now snaps to the red line when correctly positioned allowing for a more accurate read of the angles.

Blue puzzle box

- You can now open your diary when examining the blue puzzle box.

General game fix

- Interactions and menus are locked to prevent them from interrupting some auto saves.

notes.title: Update notes for December 4 / 2023
notes.content:
- Added a smoother mouse cursor movement.
- Added camera zoom-in function when using the geometry puzzle.
- Able to add fireplace clues to your diary.

notes.title: Mouse turn speed changes.
notes.content: Added X and Y axis slider in options menu
